name: Sawamura Yuuki
source:
Favorite Food: Boiled eggs, takoyaki.
Disliked Food: Sea urchin.
Works at: Imported products shop, indoor pool.

A boyish, man-hating girl who is more popular among women than men. She is fond of [url=http://vndb.org/c1918]Nami[/url] and creates a love triangle between them and the protagonist, with Nami in the center.
Yuuki shares a lot of similar traits with the protagonist. They both are: thankless, frustrated, have a dream, nosy, reckless, insensitive, and popular with girls.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=10983]Getchu (NSFW!)[/url].]
